evidence.claim: gemini-2.5-flash is a stable model name with structured outputs, 1,048,576 input tokens, and 65,536 output tokens.
Stable model names usually do not change, but are not documented as dated immutable snapshots.
Gemini API v1 is stable and can be selected explicitly in SDK HttpOptions.
generateContent returns candidates, promptFeedback, usageMetadata, modelVersion, responseId, finishReason, and safety metadata.
Gemini 2.5 Flash supports response JSON schema and integer constraints through structured output.
Gemini 2.5 thinking can be disabled with thinkingBudget=0.
google-genai provides LocalTokenizer for gemini-2.5-flash and can count system instructions plus response schemas locally.
Gemini 2.5 Flash input and output tokens are free on the free tier; free-tier content may be used to improve Google products.
